faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Chilliwack: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 2 bedroom condos sell for in Chilliwack?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Chilliwack, 139 sold over the past year at a median of $383,000, with the middle half between $310,000 and $461,250.

faq.q: How fast do 2 bedroom condos sell in Chilliwack?
faq.a: The median was 30 days, and homes sold for 96.9% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in Chilliwack do most 2 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Garrison Crossing, with 28 of the 139 sales at a median of $568,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Chilliwack have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Morningside (6 sales, median $411,500); The Vibe (5 sales, median $295,000); The York Residences (5 sales, median $450,000); The Boardwalk (5 sales, median $828,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Chilliwack?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Chilliwack was $412 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Chilliwack compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Chilliwack sold for $50,550 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($383,000 against $332,450, 82 sales). The strata fee was $412 a month against $294.
A 2 bedroom condo in Chilliwack sold for $107,000 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($383,000 against $490,000, 9 sales). The strata fee was $412 a month against $517.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Chilliwack has the lowest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
